notes: Squads fighting with snipers behind cover until one squad remains is Shooter. The static build behind the gimmick is a compact bounded floating combat grid — five by five tiles, each about a small arena — with tiles raised into high-ground fortresses above the plane and a lower hazard tier below it, so surfaces sit over surfaces and the shape is arena-stacked at P2; this was close against arena-tiered and against describing the shape outright, since no catalogue row expresses a map whose tiles rearrange mid-match. No preset: Battle Royale is the mode but the prompt explicitly replaces its closing circle with scheduled tile shifts and never mentions ground loot, so with boundary-shrinking dropped and open-battlefield contradicted by a compact grid there is no recognisable preset left. Decided without a user: the tile choreography is scripting rather than layout, so the build ships the grid, its mechanical seams, the control terminals, per-tile cover and the small buildings players camp inside (P3), and the abyss between tiles is the map limit.
